ModMetaData.name: Rim Prison
ModMetaData.author: UrekD
ModMetaData.description:
Run a prison on the rim, in the spirit of Prison Architect (work in progress).
You are the warden. The state, the penal authority of the settled worlds, sends a shuttle with inmates every day (pirates, raiders, slavers, yayo and flake smugglers, plain thieves) and pays for each one. Build a shuttle pad for it to land on, or it sets down on the nearest clear ground near holding. Your staff keep order, cook, clean, treat, teach and counsel while you paint the prison's zones, set each security level's daily regime, write the policies and keep the books.
Inmates have tension and its causes, needs, reputations and gangs. They insult, fight, smuggle, deal, dig and riot; they take programs, earn parole or remission, and some wait on death row. Staff have shifts, morale, training, breaks, debts and their own stories. Decisions arrive as letters: inspections, strikes, food scares, fires, appeals, demands, mentorships and many more, and a chronicle remembers them.
Start from "New prison" on the main menu (a new or an inherited facility). Requires Harmony.
